## Country Time Series

The ESS figure shows the mean, median, and mode of satisfaction with the state of
the economy. Open points mark country-years flagged as unreliable in the ESS
summary file. The WID figures track the shares held by the bottom 50%, middle
40%, and top 10% for net personal wealth and national income. Post-tax national
income is used where available, with pre-tax national income as a fallback. The
group shares are summed from WID's decile data, making the distribution easier
to compare over time without mixing country currencies. Net wealth shares may be
negative for groups with debt.

```{r}
#| label: country-timeseries
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_country_timeseries(country_timeseries)
```
